data.name: Ebtihaj
data.gender_notes: Ebtihaj is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘ibtahaja’ which means ‘to respect’ or ‘to be revered’. This beautiful name holds a deep spiritual significance in Islam, representing the importance of respect and reverence towards Allah and His creations. The name Ebtihaj carries the meaning “Exalted, Respected” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ebtihaj usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, respected and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ebtihaj belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Respected.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ebtihaj total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ابتھاج
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم فاعل من ابتهج يبتهج ابتهاجا، وهو الفرح والسرور، وابتھاج تعني الشخص الذي يفرح ويسر، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة الحجر آية 47، وھو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة في اللغة العربية، وتعبر عن الفرح والسرور

in_urdu.name: ابتهاج
in_urdu.meaning: خوشی اور رازق دل کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: عربی زبان کی اصطلاح 'ابتهج يبتهج ابتهاجا' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے خوشی اور فرحت، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں ایک مقبول نام ہے، جو خوبی اور خوشی کی علامت ہے، اور اردو بولنے والے ممالک میں اس کا اہمیت ہے
